Name: (CP) Grandpa's Shed Recolour - Seasonal Japanese Buildings (SVE)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This mod adds compatibility with the Seasonal Japanese Buildings and Stardew Valley Expanded!

Includes the Destroyed and Built versions

Let me know if there's any bugs!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:
 
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder


[*]You're all done!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]

Thank you so so much [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/145160698]soybutt [/url]for giving me permission to release this mod. They created the Japanese Building styled Grandpa's Shed, here's the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/3891]original page[/url]﻿.
[/list]
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3947]Seasonal Japanese Buildings[/url]﻿ (which is no longer being maintained!)
There is an updated version here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9704?tab=description]Updated Seasonal Japanese Buildings[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/87388223]Leroymilo[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22350]
[/url]
Thank you Flashshifter and the rest of the SVE team for the open asset use permission. Checkout the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Main Mod[/url]﻿!

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley :)[/center]
